name: strict-verification-evidence
note: Mandatory shape of VERIFICATION_REGISTRY.json. The gate pins these lists to its own canonical contract (V-12): editing this file alone cannot weaken the gate.

evidence_semantics.reviewer: one of reviewers; must equal the slot the evidence is attached to (V-09)
evidence_semantics.kind: evidence class; every item needs >=1 positive/runtime AND >=1 negative/adversarial/failure_recovery (V-11)
evidence_semantics.command: reproducible command; may not be solely a self-certification module (V-08)
evidence_semantics.sha256: sha256 hex of the artifact bytes (V-02)
evidence_semantics.head_sha: 40-hex commit the evidence was produced on; must equal registry head_bound and gate HEAD (V-02/V-06)

human_governance.semantics: requires_human_approval and human_approved must be literally true (absent key = fail, V-10); approver must be a human, not one of the three AI reviewers (V-10); head_sha must equal gate HEAD (V-02/V-06)

false_green_allowlist_entry.semantics: pattern must be a known scanner label; expires is 'never' or a future date; optional path scopes approval to one file so gate-internal literals cannot blanket-approve the repo (V-07)
